### AudioCategory

Types: [`AudioCategory`](AudioCategory.md)

How the game's audio sits with other apps' and the silent switch. The default is [`AudioCategory.Ambient`](AudioCategory.md#ambient).

### AutoHidesHomeIndicator

```csharp
public bool AutoHidesHomeIndicator { get; set; }
```

Whether the home indicator fades away after a moment without touches, which suits a game and is the default. It comes back with a touch.

### DeferredSystemGestureEdges

```csharp
public UIRectEdge DeferredSystemGestureEdges { get; set; }
```

The screen edges where a swipe reaches the game first, and the system's gesture needs a second one. All of them by default, as a game's drag shouldn't open Control Center.
